notes.title: Learning to Bear – Patch Notes v1.31
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes v1.31[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where minimap hints were being added multiple times.
[*] Any duplicates will now be automatically removed when the next hint is collected.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Optional quests are now removed after leaving a mission to keep the quest log clean.
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]Quest remove feature[/b]: you can now permanently delete quests using the X button in the quest log — helpful for players with outdated or broken quests.
[/list]

[list]
[*] The Moving Climb mission now correctly has a follow-up quest.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added notifications for unnspent talent points and new abilities granted during missions

[/list]

Thanks for playing!

[i] if you encounter any issues please let me know![/i] 🐻

tags.bug: [*] Fixed an issue where minimap hints were being added multiple times.
[*] Any duplicates will now be automatically removed when the next hint is collected.

tags.feature: [*] Optional quests are now removed after leaving a mission to keep the quest log clean.
[*] [b]Quest remove feature[/b]: you can now permanently delete quests using the X button in the quest log — helpful for players with outdated or broken quests.

tags.feature: [*] Added notifications for unnspent talent points and new abilities granted during missions

notes.title: Learning to Bear V1.30
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes v1.30[/b]


[*] Puzzle Domes have been added on the Island of Roo!
[*] Solve the puzzle to unlock rewards: a rune, runeword, or item chest.
[*] These domes respawn and are farmable, so happy hunting!


[list]
[*] Wingsuit missions must now be completed in order to unlock progression.
[/list]
[list]
[*] The Story Book now has a pause/play button for better pacing.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Basic Training has been shortened to get you into the action faster.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Skinshop Buy button is now fixed.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Vendors can now be closed using the Escape key.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Small bugfixes
[/list]

[i]Good luck out there agent ![/i]

notes.title: Learning to Bear V1.28
notes.content:
[h2]Patch Notes – v1.28[/h2]

[b]Fixed overlapping notifications[/b] that could clutter the screen.

[b]Updated quest system[/b]:

[list]

[/list]

Small bug fixes and general improvements to performance and stability.


[i]Thanks for playing and supporting the game![/i]
